birthday.seoTitle: Birthday Wishlist: Share What You Want With One Link {'|'} Wishly
birthday.seoDesc: Not sure what to get for a birthday? Check their birthday wishlist first. Create a birthday wishlist on Wishly and share one link with friends. Claimed items are locked, so you never get duplicate gifts or have to awkwardly ask.
birthday.heading: Birthday Wishlist: Let Your Friends Know What You Really Want
intro: Around every birthday, the most common question is "What do you want?" The answer is usually "anything is fine," so the giver guesses, and you end up with something you will never use, or two people buy the same gift.
Put what you want on a birthday wishlist first. Friends open the link and know exactly where to look, no more answering the same message one by one, and no awkwardness about asking.

On Wishly, an item is locked once a friend claims it, and everyone else can see that someone is already giving it, so nothing gets duplicated. Want to be surprised? Turn on surprise mode and you will not see who gave what.

steps.d: Sign in and add a new list, for example "My birthday wishes," then add what you want one item at a time. You can also add curated products from Gift inspiration in one tap.
Pick Public, All friends, Selected friends or Only me. To keep the surprise, turn on surprise mode.

steps.t: Share the link and let friends claim
steps.d: Copy the list link and send it to a group chat or in a message. Public lists can be viewed without signing in. For lists limited to friends or selected people, friends must sign in and be on the visible list. Claiming requires signing in, and a claimed item is locked.

ideas.d: A wide price range and easy to choose, a good option when you are unsure of the budget.
Used every day. List your preferred size and color so nobody gets it wrong.
Models vary a lot, so picking the exact one yourself is the safest.
Skin type and taste are personal. Listing what you would actually use is the most accurate.
Your to-read pile is probably long. Add it to the list and let friends choose freely.
Coffee makers, air fryers and other things you want but hesitate to buy are perfect for friends to chip in on.
Size and use are specific, so spell them out and nobody has to guess.
A favorite restaurant, a class or an exhibition. Be sure to describe exactly what you would like to do.
For pricier items, use wish crowdfunding so everyone can chip in with points.

faq.q: Can I show my birthday list only to certain friends?
faq.a: Yes. A list can be Public, All friends, Selected friends or Close friends, or Only me. You can share it only with the people you want to invite.

faq.q: I want a surprise. How come I can't see who gave what?
faq.a: Turn on surprise mode and set your birthday as the event date. Until then you only see how complete the list is, not who gave what, and the names unlock on the day. Friends still see that an item is claimed, so gifts are not duplicated.

faq.q: What if a friend claims something and never gives it?
faq.a: Claims expire. A claim that is not completed in time is released automatically and the item opens up again for others, so it never stays stuck.

wedding.heading: Wedding Registry: Get Wedding Gifts You Will Actually Use
intro: When you are getting married, relatives and friends keep asking privately, "What do you need?" Couples feel shy about answering, and end up with three toasters, four dinner sets, or décor they cannot use, all of it a hassle to return.
Put what your new home really needs on a wedding registry. Guests open it and know what to give, with choices at every budget and no awkwardness on either side.
Claimed items are locked, so nothing is given twice. For pricey things like large appliances, set up wish crowdfunding so several guests can chip in with points and share the cost.

steps.t: List what your new home needs
steps.d: Sign in and create "Our wedding registry," then add appliances, bedding, tableware and more. Include items from low to high prices so guests on any budget can pick.
Make it Public, or limit it to friends, selected friends or close friends. To keep it a surprise, turn on surprise mode.

steps.t: Send the link to your guests
steps.d: Paste it in the wedding group chat or add it to your e-invitation. Guests can view a public list without signing in, while lists limited to friends or selected people need a sign-in. Claiming only requires signing in, and the item is locked once claimed.

faq.q: Can I put cash gifts on the list?
faq.a: No. Wishly does not handle cash gifts or collect money on your behalf. To let guests share the cost of a big item, use wish crowdfunding, where they chip in with platform points.

faq.q: Where do points for wish crowdfunding come from?
faq.a: You can top up points yourself. Guests contribute points toward an item, and it only counts as complete once the goal is reached. Points are used within the platform and are not a cash gift.

faq.q: Can older relatives who do not use smartphones see the list?
faq.a: Yes. A list is just a web link. If it is Public, no sign-in is needed to view it. If it is limited to friends or selected people, viewers must sign in and be on the visible list. Claiming an item always requires a member account.

baby.heading: Baby Registry and New Baby Gift List: Organize Newborn Essentials in One Place
intro: Around the time a baby arrives, family and friends all want to help but do not know what the parents need. You often end up with piles of bottles, blankets and clothes, in sizes too small to wear or in brands and materials that do not suit you.

Put your hospital bag and newborn essentials on a baby registry first. Parents can note sizes, specs and preferences, and guests just pick from the list, with no repeated questions and no gifts you cannot use.

Claimed items are locked, so nothing is given twice. Consumables like diapers and clothing can be split across price points, while big-ticket items like strollers and car seats suit wish crowdfunding so everyone can chip in.

steps.t: Add what you need to the list
steps.d: Sign in and create a list, adding items in batches by hospital bag, clothing, bedding and on-the-go gear, with sizes and preferences in the notes. You can also pick baby gifts from Gift inspiration.
Baby details are personal, so we suggest All friends or Selected friends or Close friends. If you do not want to share it, set it to Only me.

steps.t: Share the link with family and friends
steps.d: Send it to grandparents, coworkers and friends. For lists limited to friends or selected people, guests must sign in and be on the visible list (only Public lists can be viewed without signing in). faq.q: Can I put hospital bag items on the list?
faq.a: Yes. Each hospital bag item can be added separately with its size or specs. Once someone claims it, the item is locked and nobody else will prepare it.

Claimed items are locked, so nothing is given twice. For pricier things like a sofa or large appliances, use wish crowdfunding so a few friends can chip in with points and no one has to cover it all.

christmas.heading: Christmas Wishlist: Organize Secret Santa and Your Own Wishes in One Place
intro: Before Christmas, the office runs a gift exchange and family and friends want to swap small gifts, and the biggest worry is "What does this person actually like?" After all that guessing, you often hand over something generic, and the receiver can only politely say thank you.

Put what you want on a Christmas wishlist, and whoever draws your name can pick from it. There are clear options within the budget, so it is never awkward, nobody overspends or underspends, and your Secret Santa saves time on guessing.

Claimed items are locked, so nothing is given twice. If you want to keep the surprise when you receive gifts, turn on surprise mode so you cannot see who gave what. Unwrapping stays exciting, and friends will not give the same gift.

steps.d: Sign in and add a new list, adding what you want by price, and include a few at the usual gift exchange budgets. Gift inspiration has seasonal picks you can add in one tap.
Choose Public, All friends, Selected friends or Only me. To keep the surprise, turn on surprise mode.

Paste it in a group chat or send it to your gift exchange partner. A public list can be viewed without signing in, while lists limited to friends or selected people need a sign-in. Sign in to claim, and the item is locked once claimed. Claims not completed in time are released automatically.

faq.q: Can I use this list for my office gift exchange?
faq.a: Yes. Send the list link to whoever drew your name. If the list is Public, they can view it without signing in. If it is limited to friends, they must sign in and be your friend. Claiming always requires signing in. You can also include items at different prices to match the exchange budget.

faq.q: Will I know who gave me a gift?
faq.a: By default, yes. To keep the surprise, turn on surprise mode and set an event date (for example December 25). Until that day you cannot see who gave what, and the names unlock on the day.

faq.q: Can one list be shared with both family and friends?
faq.a: Yes. You can share one list with many people, and limit it to All friends, Selected friends or Close friends if you like. Once an item is claimed it is locked, so nobody gives it twice.
